turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I've got until 4:40, so let's start with why my son found out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class.
Okay. Who decided to enter the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen or call me before it went in?
Ms. Kalinowski, you're a lawyer. Honestly, what would you do in my position?
You're asking me how to do your job? Withdraw the zero, Hale. Then answer my question: who decided, and was Owen heard first?
No really, give me advice. How should I handle this?
I'm not here to advise you, Hale. I'm here about Owen. The zero comes off, and I'm still waiting for you to tell me who decided and whether anyone spoke to him first.
